sections.title: Layered shell mark
sections.description: Use the mark to express explicit composition around a user-owned core.

rules.instruction: Pair the mark with the Mantle name on first-use product and repository surfaces.
rules.rationale: The layered prompt remains recognizable without making a new user infer the project name.

rules.instruction: Do not surround the mark with fake commands, decorative code, or unverified status output.
rules.rationale: Terminal language should communicate real product state, not visual atmosphere.
details: Show only real commands and truthful state labels

assets.label: Mantle layered shell mark
assets.notes: Use only the approved source or verified generated projections.

accessibility.summary: Commands, state, consequence, and recovery must remain understandable without color, motion, or the mark.
rules: Never use color as the only status signal
Keep terminal and document text at WCAG AA contrast or better

legal.trademark: Mantle names and marks identify this project without implying endorsement.
legal.attribution: Preserve the governed attribution when distributing the mark.
